$comment: Single source for the CI build matrix (.github/workflows/windows-x64.yaml).
Archive names are not listed here: CMakeLists.txt derives them from the port versions
cuda: full toolkit versions, installed from NVIDIA's redistributable archives
whisper_from_cuda: the variant whose whisper-windows-x64-<whisper>.zip is published. whisper.dll and
parakeet.dll only import ggml.dll/ggml-base.dll (GGML_BACKEND_DL), so the build is CUDA-agnostic.
vulkan_sdk: LunarG Vulkan SDK version installed on the runner.
